Predict Fielding Independent Pitching

predict_fip.Rd

Predicts a pitcher's fielding independent pitching based on statistics from their most recent season.

Usage

predict_fip(
  age,
  babip,
  hr_fb,
  xera,
  xfip,
  ip,
  lob_pct,
  k_pct,
  bb_pct,
  barrel_pct,
  hardhit_pct,
  is_starter,
  is_reliever,
  data = Pitching
)

Arguments

age

Pitcher age during the specific season.

babip

Batting average on balls in play.

hr_fb

Home-run-to-fly-ball rate.

xera

Expected earned run average.

xfip

Expected fielding independent pitching.

ip

Innings pitched.

lob_pct

Left-on-base percentage.

k_pct

Strikeout percentage.

bb_pct

Walk percentage.

barrel_pct

Barrel percentage.

hardhit_pct

Hard-hit percentage.

is_starter

Numeric indicator equal to 1 if the pitcher can be classified as a starter and 0 otherwise.

is_reliever

Numeric indicator equal to 1 if the pitcher can be classified as a reliever and 0 otherwise.

data

Pitching dataset used to fit the projection model.

Value

Predicted fielding independent pitching for the following season as a numeric value rounded to two decimal places.

starter_example <-predict_fip( age = 25, babip = 0.251, hr_fb = 9.1, xera = 2.85, xfip = 2.86, ip = 193.2, lob_pct = 81.7, k_pct = 31.4, bb_pct = 6.4, barrel_pct = 7.3, hardhit_pct = 38.1, is_starter = 1, is_reliever = 0 ) starter_example

reliever_example <-predict_fip( age = 26, babip = 0.279, hr_fb = 13, xera = 2.52, xfip = 2.36, ip = 68.2, lob_pct = 77, k_pct = 37.8, bb_pct = 9.8, barrel_pct = 6.2, hardhit_pct = 42.5, is_starter = 0, is_reliever = 1 ) reliever_example

swingman_example <-predict_fip( age = 27, babip = 0.272, hr_fb = 15.2, xera = 3.55, xfip = 4.09, ip = 132.2, lob_pct = 73.3, k_pct = 28.7, bb_pct = 6.5, barrel_pct = 9.9, hardhit_pct = 36.9, is_starter = 1, is_reliever = 1 ) swingman_example

Details

Predictors are standardized before the regression model is fitted. The standardized coefficient for expected fielding independent pitching (xFIP) is constrained to be at least twice as large in absolute value as every other predictor coefficient.
